title: Implement: apply a function n times

checklist.step: Apply f exactly n times, afresh on every call, even for n = 3000
Show the value after every application

hints: Applying f several times means the output of one application is the input of the next.
The count n belongs to repeated; the value that changes belongs to one call of the function it returns.
Inside the returned function start from x and loop n times, replacing the value with f(value). A loop, not n functions nested inside one another.
